question: Can I buy service credit for prior service, such as military service or another government job?

gold_sections.ref: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-307

nuggets.text: In the year of retirement a member may purchase up to 10 years of eligibility service for listed prior employment.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-307
nuggets.quote: in the year of retirement, a member of the Employees’ Pension System may purchase credit for eligibility service of up to 10 years

nuggets.text: The member files a claim on the Board's form.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-307
nuggets.quote: complete a claim for the service credit and file it with the Board of Trustees on the form that the Board of Trustees provides; and

nuggets.text: The member pays the annuity and pension reserves that fund the extra allowance.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-307
nuggets.quote: pay to the Board of Trustees an amount equal to the annuity reserve and pension reserve required to fund the additional allowance.

notes: The Employees' Pension System's purchase rule; each system has its own purchase sections.
